lede: Clemson carries the stronger underlying team rating — +2.7 against -4.4, a 7.1-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it California +4.5 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Clemson winning 62% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is performance, where Clemson leads California by 54 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 79% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
